output.reason: [ev-5a31c0781dc5] and the upgrade guide [ev-1295567312b0] say the `istiod-remote` Helm chart has been merged into the `istio-discovery` chart. Installs that used `helm install istiod-remote istio/istiod-remote` must now use `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote`. [ev-274ce3859ab9] confirms the `istiod-remote` chart is removed. That makes this an operator step, so the migration family with migration-required is the right choice. The kebab-case name 'istiod-remote-to-remote-profile' is short, clear and built from the evidence's own key words.
